sources.title: GitHub - maharab549/ultron-ai: ULTRON AI - Open Source Manus AI ...
sources.snippet: ULTRON AI is an open-source, general-purpose AI agent system that can autonomously plan, reason and execute complex tasks. Give it a goal and it will break it down, use tools, browse the web, write code, manipulate files, and deliver results — all inside a secure sandboxed environment. Think of it as your own self-hosted alternative to Manus AI, ChatGPT with Code Interpreter, or Devin ...
